newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine students try to burn school.
newsitem.headline: Philippine students try to burn school.

text.p: Seven teenagers, angered by a teacher's scolding, tried to burn down their school in Quezon City, just north of Manila, police said.
The students, aged 15 to 16, were arrested on Wednesday night soon after they lobbed blazing bottles filled with kerosene onto the school roof, police said.
The fire was quickly put out by school guards. Police said the students would be charged with attempted arson.
"They will be expelled from school," a school official said.
